surface: src/plate_core/autonomy.py get_budget_snapshot, plate_what_next budget_gate, gh plate costs/autonomy budget UX
summary: Fix #795: get_budget_snapshot ignores prior-UTC-day durable spend (match AutonomyEngine._load_durable_spend) so what_next/feed no longer report false exhausted after day rollover.
migration_impact: After upgrade, budget snapshots and plate_what_next treat yesterday's spend.json counters as zero until a same-day charge rewrites the file. Same-day spend behavior unchanged.
migration_guidance: 1. Upgrade plate-core so get_budget_snapshot applies UTC day rollover.
2. Optional: delete stale .agentic/budget/spend.json if operators want a clean same-day file (not required).
agent_notes: If what_next says budget_gate exhausted but autonomy --status shows full remaining, ensure this fix is present. Prefer status remaining from snapshot after day rollover. Do not delete spend without cause when date is today.
